Name: Aimon's Tidy Cozy Cellar
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/TTYyVRK/features.png[/img][/url]
[color=#efefef]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]A relatively small cellar map with mor realistic and detailed layout,
You can add extra 2nd floor room and change walls recolor in mod's config![/size][/font][/color][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]


[url=https://imgbb.com/]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/6YTbvZx/installation.png[/img][/url]
[/size][/font][list=1]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Install all the required mods[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Unpack the mod archive and place it into your Mods folder,[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Done!﻿﻿﻿[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]
[/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]NOTE: ﻿For stardew 1.5.6 you'll also need Extra Map Layers mod
[color=#ff7700][url=https://imgbb.com/]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/BtYWk8N/config.png[/img][/url]   [/color]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]ModEnabled - true, false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Recolor - Dark, Light[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Cellar size - Big, Small[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Wooden floor sections - true, false[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]
[url=https://imgbb.com/] ﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/KyrMLtF/compability.png[/img][/url] 
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][color=#00ff00]Compatible[/color] with any recolor [/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][color=#00ff00]Compatible[/color] with Fancy Farmhouse, Tidy Cozy Farmhouse, [/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4] [s]Lnh's First FarmHouse, Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2, Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 (Unofficial Update), Tiny Farmhouse [/s](don't know about compatibility for those mods in 1.6 yet).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][color=#00ff00]Compatible[/color] with expansions (SVE, Ridgeside, ect..)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][color=#ff0000]Not compatible[/color] with any mods that edit cellar map[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][color=#ff0000]Not compatible[/color] with Permanent Cellar mod[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]
[color=#ff7700][url=https://imgbb.com/]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/34knJbB/known-bugs-and-issues-faq.png[/img][/url]    [/color]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]This mod works fine if you'll install it on already existing save file.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][color=#ffff00][u]VERY IMPORTANT! [/u][/color]Before deleting this mod from your Mods folder - please, pick up all your casks and other furniture from the cellar (it can disappear after you delete this mod or install other cellar mod).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Wall furniture (like banners or paintings) cannot be placed on walls in cellar - it's hardcoded. All other furniture like tables, couches, ect.. is fine tho.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]You can't change floor texture -  it's hardcoded.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]After Robin finish cellar upgrade, the default casks spawn position will be offsetted - you'll need to relocate them by hand.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][b][color=#f9cb9c][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=3][center][/center][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/color][/b]
